description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides a wrapper around REST API calls for a backend server. It includes functions for health checks, capabilities retrieval, session management, chat messaging, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech operations, using fetch API and handling JSON data and errors.

methods.name: readErrorBody(res)
methods.description: Reads error information from a fetch response, attempting JSON first, then text, and defaulting to 'Unknown error'.

methods.name: getBackendBaseUrl()
methods.description: Constructs the backend API base URL from environment variables or window location.

methods.name: withBase(path)
methods.description: Prefix a given path with the backend base URL.

methods.name: withJsonHeaders(init = {})
methods.description: Adds appropriate JSON headers to a fetch request init object.

methods.name: arrayBufferToBase64(buf)
methods.description: Converts an ArrayBuffer to a base64 string in a browser-safe way.

methods.name: safeStringify(value)
methods.description: Stringifies a value to JSON, falling back to String conversion if stringify fails.

methods.name: getBackendInfo()
methods.description: Returns the backend HTTP and WebSocket base URLs.

methods.name: getHealth({ signal } = {})
methods.description: Performs a health check GET request to the backend root.

methods.name: getCapabilities({ signal } = {})
methods.description: Fetches the backend capabilities such as providers and event types.

methods.name: createSession({ userId = null, metadata = {} } = {}, { signal } = {})
methods.description: Creates a new session with optional user ID and metadata.

methods.name: chat({ sessionId, text, stream = false }, { signal } = {})
methods.description: Sends a chat message to the backend session and returns the response.

methods.name: stt({ sessionId, audioBlob, mimeType = "audio/webm", language = null })
methods.description: Performs speech-to-text conversion by uploading audio blob.

methods.name: tts({ sessionId, text, voice = null, mimeType = "audio/wav" })
methods.description: Performs text-to-speech conversion, returning audio data.

ctags.name: chat
ctags.pattern: /^export async function chat({ sessionId, text, stream = false }, { signal } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: createSession
ctags.pattern: /^export async function createSession({ userId = null, metadata = {} } = {}, { signal } = {}) {$/

ctags.name: stt
ctags.pattern: /^export async function stt({ sessionId, audioBlob, mimeType = "audio\/webm", language = null }) {$/

ctags.name: tts
ctags.pattern: /^export async function tts({ sessionId, text, voice = null, mimeType = "audio\/wav" }) {$/
